symbols_and_definitions: E=electric-field strength; V=applied voltage; d=electrode gap
symbol_units: E: V/m; V: V; d: m
applicability: Parallel or approximately uniform electrode geometry
original_material: general electrical definition; applied to source-reported alfalfa chamber
source_title: Pulsed electric field assisted juice extraction from alfalfa
authors: T.K. Gachovska; M.O. Ngadi; G.S.V. Raghavan
exact_source_location: Methods report voltage and electrode gaps, pp. 3.34-3.35
limitations: Assumes field equals voltage divided by gap; fringe fields and chamber nonuniformity are not represented.

symbols_and_definitions: W_pulse=stored capacitor energy per pulse; C=capacitance; V=charging voltage
symbol_units: W_pulse: J; C: F; V: V
limitations: Stored energy is not equal to energy delivered to biomass unless circuit losses, waveform and residual voltage are known. Therefore no specific-energy value was calculated for the alfalfa study.

symbols_and_definitions: Z=cell-disintegration index; σ=sample conductivity; σ_i=intact-tissue conductivity; σ_d=fully disintegrated-tissue conductivity
applicability: Conductivity-based tissue disintegration with matched temperature and geometry
exact_source_location: not reported in reviewed direct studies
limitations: Requires experimentally measured intact and fully disintegrated reference conductivities; temperature dependence must be controlled.

symbols_and_definitions: c_t=protein content at time t; c_0=initial protein content; c_∞=final protein content; k=extraction rate; t=time
symbol_units: c values: consistent protein-content unit; k: min^-1; t: min
applicability: Pumpkin leaf protein extraction under tested probe-ultrasound conditions
original_material: ground and lyophilized pumpkin leaves in water
source_title: Ultrasound as Green Technology for the Valorization of Pumpkin Leaves: Intensification of Protein Recovery
authors: Jelena Mijalković; Nataša Šekuljica; Sonja Jakovetić Tanasković; Predrag Petrović; Bojana Balanč; Marija Korićanac; Ana Conić; Jelena Bakrač; Verica Đorđević; Branko Bugarski; Zorica Knežević-Jugović
limitations: Do not infer k. Source-fitted constants were not transcribed because exact tabulated values were not available in accessible text. Fresh wet grass requires refitting.

symbols_and_definitions: Y=soluble protein extraction yield; m_ex=mass extracted soluble protein; m_t=soluble protein mass at time t; m_0=soluble protein mass at t=0; m'_0=protein content in raw leaf sample
symbol_units: Y: %; masses: mg or any consistent mass unit
original_material: ground and lyophilized pumpkin leaves in water
source_title: Ultrasound as Green Technology for the Valorization of Pumpkin Leaves: Intensification of Protein Recovery
authors: Jelena Mijalković; Nataša Šekuljica; Sonja Jakovetić Tanasković; Predrag Petrović; Bojana Balanč; Marija Korićanac; Ana Conić; Jelena Bakrač; Verica Đorđević; Branko Bugarski; Zorica Knežević-Jugović
limitations: Denominator must be raw-leaf protein content, not slurry protein or final concentrate mass.

symbols_and_definitions: e_spec=specific acoustic energy; P_acoustic=calorimetrically measured acoustic power; t=sonication time; m=treated mass
symbol_units: e_spec: J/kg; P: W; t: s; m: kg
applicability: Batch ultrasound when actual delivered acoustic power and treated mass are measured
exact_source_location: not directly reported in source study
limitations: Do not use generator input power as acoustic power without calorimetric calibration. Slurry mass was not explicitly reported, so no specific energy was calculated.

symbols_and_definitions: P_acoustic=delivered acoustic power; m=sample mass; c_p=specific heat capacity; dT/dt=initial temperature-rise rate
symbol_units: P: W; m: kg; c_p: J/(kg K); dT/dt: K/s
applicability: Calorimetric calibration over initial near-adiabatic interval
limitations: Requires measured time-resolved temperature and heat-capacity data; cooling jacket invalidates a simple adiabatic interpretation unless corrected.
